name: mobility-database-catalogs
what_it_holds: A global catalog (JSON files per feed + a consolidated CSV at files.mobilitydatabase.org/feeds_v2.csv, plus a Python API) of public GTFS Schedule and GTFS Realtime feeds worldwide, filterable by country/subdivision/bounding box/status. Not rail-company-specific but a discovery layer for whichever rail/bus GTFS feeds (SNCF TER/Intercités, Trenitalia, FlixBus, regional EU operators) are publicly published.
why_useful: Matches gap #17 (Socrata/CKAN-style open-data discovery client) applied to transit: a single machine-readable index to find and pull SNCF/DB/Trenitalia/FlixBus schedule (capacity/frequency) feeds without hand-hunting each operator's portal.
time_coverage: live/current feeds only (schedules, not historical ridership)
license: repo MIT/Apache-style; underlying feeds vary by operator
themes: Rail and ground travel: Amtrak ridership, SNCF/DB/Trenitalia open data, Eurostar, bus (FlixBus), rideshare datasets (Uber Movement), NYC TLC airport trips, Chicago taxi
why_all: Matches gap #17 (Socrata/CKAN-style open-data discovery client) applied to transit: a single machine-readable index to find and pull SNCF/DB/Trenitalia/FlixBus schedule (capacity/frequency) feeds without hand-hunting each operator's portal.

name: georgekhananaev/google-reviews-scraper-pro
what_it_holds: Actively maintained (updated Sep 2026) Python scraper for Google Maps/Google Business reviews: multi-language review extraction with review dates, images, MongoDB storage, incremental re-scraping (so it can build a review-velocity time series per business/location over repeated runs), and anti-detection handling. 329 stars, MIT licence. No data committed — a tool only.
why_useful: A working, actively-maintained method to build a time series of review volume/ratings for restaurants, attractions, and short-term-rental-adjacent leisure businesses in specific markets (proxy for local leisure/tourism activity levels feeding nights/ADR by region); scrapes Google, not Airbnb, so it is a methods-only flag per the run rules, not to be executed here.
themes: Restaurant and leisure proxies: OpenTable state of the industry CSV, Yelp dataset, Google Maps reviews scrapers, event ticket data
Hotel and STR reviews as demand: review velocity datasets (Google, TripAdvisor, Booking) with dates; review-based nowcasting repos
why_all: A working, actively-maintained method to build a time series of review volume/ratings for restaurants, attractions, and short-term-rental-adjacent leisure businesses in specific markets (proxy for local leisure/tourism activity levels feeding nights/ADR by region); scrapes Google, not Airbnb, so it is a methods-only flag per the run rules, not to be executed here.

Could be pointed at hotel/short-term-rental listings on Google Maps to build a review-count-by-date velocity series as a demand nowcast for specific markets, complementing the existing Inside Airbnb reviews-based stays index with an independent (non-Airbnb) hotel-sector read. Running it against any specific site is a ToS decision for a human per repo rules; catalogued as method only.

name: omkarcloud/google-maps-reviews-scraper
what_it_holds: Extracts Google Maps reviews with content, ratings, timestamps, original language + translation, and keyword-filterable review search. MIT license, 31 commits, no sample data committed.
why_useful: Same class of tool as above — could be pointed at restaurants/attractions/hotels in ABNB-relevant markets to build a leisure-activity/engagement proxy series; no data committed, method only.
themes: Restaurant and leisure proxies: OpenTable state of the industry CSV, Yelp dataset, Google Maps reviews scrapers, event ticket data
Hotel and STR reviews as demand: review velocity datasets (Google, TripAdvisor, Booking) with dates; review-based nowcasting repos
why_all: Same class of tool as above — could be pointed at restaurants/attractions/hotels in ABNB-relevant markets to build a leisure-activity/engagement proxy series; no data committed, method only.

Could build a review-volume-over-time series (a nowcast proxy for foot traffic/leisure activity at specific venues or markets) similar to the team's existing Inside Airbnb reviews-based stays index methodology.
Same use case as georgekhananaev's tool above (review-velocity nowcast building block for hotels/STRs on Google Maps); a second, differently-built option in case one is blocked or deprecated.

Timestamped Google review pulls are the cleanest 'review velocity' signal available (Google reviews are the largest and most current review pool for lodging businesses) -- directly on-theme for a review-count nowcast built per city/market to compare against Inside Airbnb's own review-based stays index.

name: gosom/google-maps-scraper
what_it_holds: Go/Playwright based scraper extracting 36+ fields per Google Maps business listing (name, address, GPS, rating, review count, reviews with timestamps/ratings, hours, price range, categories). CLI/Web UI/REST API/self-hosted SaaS modes, Docker/Kubernetes support. MIT license, ~5,800 stars, 333 commits, actively maintained.
why_useful: A working, well-maintained method to pull rating/review-volume time series for restaurants and leisure venues by city as a local leisure/tourism-activity proxy, and potentially for competitor STR listings' Google Maps presence; usable within the fee-panel style sanctioned scraping decision (a human call per rules).
themes: Restaurant and leisure proxies: OpenTable state of the industry CSV, Yelp dataset, Google Maps reviews scrapers, event ticket data
why_all: A working, well-maintained method to pull rating/review-volume time series for restaurants and leisure venues by city as a local leisure/tourism-activity proxy, and potentially for competitor STR listings' Google Maps presence; usable within the fee-panel style sanctioned scraping decision (a human call per rules).

name: omkarcloud/google-maps-scraper
what_it_holds: Python Google Maps business scraper, 50+ fields (name, address, phone, website, emails, socials, ratings, reviews), CLI + Python/Node API, free tier 200 searches/month. MIT license, ~3.5k stars, 209 commits.
why_useful: Alternative/competing Google Maps scraping method to gosom's for leisure/restaurant/venue density and rating trends by market; same leisure-proxy rationale.
themes: Restaurant and leisure proxies: OpenTable state of the industry CSV, Yelp dataset, Google Maps reviews scrapers, event ticket data
Hotel and STR reviews as demand: review velocity datasets (Google, TripAdvisor, Booking) with dates; review-based nowcasting repos
why_all: Alternative/competing Google Maps scraping method to gosom's for leisure/restaurant/venue density and rating trends by market; same leisure-proxy rationale.

Widely used, high-star general-purpose method to pull Google Maps ratings/review-count per business (hotels, STR-adjacent venues) as a demand proxy; also usable for gap #9 (competitor supply counts) by querying hotel/vacation-rental categories by city.
